title: Huawei Convicted, EU's Ukraine Funding Fight, Houthis Near Aden | Daily Crux
description_html:
A US jury has convicted Huawei, European Union leaders meet to decide how to fund Ukraine through 2027, and Houthi fighters are closing in on the Yemeni city of Aden next to a key shipping route. So what does it mean for you? Today's three main stories explain what is known, what is not, how each affects you wherever you live, and what you should do. Plus world headlines from Iran, Estonia, Congo, Russia and India.

Sources
According to official reports and statements: US Department of Justice and court reporting on the Huawei trial, Huawei statements, European Council and European Commission, Ukrainian government figures, Saudi-led coalition and Yemeni government statements, UN, Estonian government, Congo government and WHO figures, Kremlin statements, Ministry of External Affairs (India).
